tool_description: Returns the risk-free rate for a given date. Geography and proxy (duration) are customizable. Treasury Bonds and Bills are used as source.
name: Risk Free Rate API
title: Risk Free Rate API

api_list.name: Risk Free Rate
api_list.description:
This endpoint returns the risk free rate for a specific date. Default values are:

date = yesterday
geography = US
duration = 3m

Currently only US is supported. Durations supported are 3m, 5y and 10y. Historical values are supported until 1960-01-04.
